messages.text:
To match the benchmark, the required end state is a directly runnable Python CLI whose outputs match the official xsv for the listed subcommands.

The source and tests define the contracts, so the next move is a single targeted read of those command modules and tests before editing; a wrong direction would be guessing argparse behavior from memory instead of the Rust usage strings and probes.
